---
title: "Data infrastructure"
---

The workstation uses complementary storage systems rather than treating sync,
version control, and backup as interchangeable.

| Area | Default location | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Git repositories | `~/repos` | Source code, documentation, text-based projects, and versioned configuration. |
| Nextcloud folders | `~/Nextcloud` | Synced documents, PDFs, media, and shared project folders. |
| Local workstation data | `~/workstation` | Local working data that is not managed through Git or Nextcloud. |
| HDD backup | External HDD | Versioned encrypted backup of local workstation data through Vorta/Borg. |

Read the service-specific pages before deciding where data belongs:

- **[HDD/Borg](hdd_borg.qmd):** Recoverable, versioned copies of local data.
- **[GitHub](github.qmd):** Remote collaboration and version history for Git repositories.
- **[Nextcloud](nextcloud.qmd):** File synchronization for documents and shared folders.
